name: pwshpy
description: A genuinely Pythonic PowerShell: typed records and a lazy pipeline over native OS bindings, never a pwsh.exe subprocess and never text parsing. Ships the using-pwsh skill: use pwshpy (the `from pwshpy import ps` library and the `pwshpy` CLI) instead of writing or debugging PowerShell / .ps1, and translate cmdlets and .ps1 scripts to it.
